parts.text: Explain the terms gene, genotype and phenotype.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
A monohybrid genetic cross can be carried out to produce an $F_1$ and an $F_2$ generation.

- Outline how a monohybrid genetic cross is carried out.
- State the expected percentage of each of the different offspring genotypes in the $F_2$ generation.

Assume that the inheritance pattern is for autosomal dominant and recessive alleles.
